newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE Sept canola up C$10 limit as commercials buy.
newsitem.headline: WCE Sept canola up C$10 limit as commercials buy.

text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange September canola futures rose the C$10 a tonne limit on commercial and local buying as Cargill sold, traders said.
"It's mainly commercial buying with some local buying, and Cargill's the seller," a trader said.
The rally in Chicago soy futures contributed to Canola's rise, traders said.
WCE September canola rose the C$10 a tonne limit at 0948 CDT to C$348 as did July canola to C$383.90 but its limits were expanded to C$15 until Wednesday after it closed limit up on Friday.
Other canola futures were sharply higher from C$7 to C$9.30 a tonne up.
